name: AutoWFBench CRM Lead Qualification
description: Qualifies an inbound support automation inquiry from public evidence, updates and verifies the existing CRM lead, creates follow-up, sends a cautious response, and emits the completion contract with bounded retry.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({operation: 'followup.create', arguments: {lead_id: $('Policy assessment').first().json.lead_id, type: $('Policy assessment').first().json.type, status: $('Policy assessment').first().json.followStatus}}) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({operation: 'customer.send', arguments: {recipient: $('Customer response plan').first().json.recipient, body: $('Customer response plan').first().json.body}}) }}

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify({protocol_version: '1.0', run_id: $env.AWB_RUN_ID, status: $json.status, final_answer: $json.final_answer, artifacts: $json.artifacts, trace: $json.trace}) }}

nodeGroups.name: Gather evidence
nodeGroups.description: Read public inquiry, policy, research and current lead; check authorized contact and prepare missing questions.

nodeGroups.name: Qualify and assess
nodeGroups.description: Ask for missing facts once, apply policy criteria and map only supported CRM changes.

nodeGroups.name: Update and verify CRM
nodeGroups.description: Recover bounded transient update failures and verify intended fields plus protected lead identity.

nodeGroups.name: Create follow-up
nodeGroups.description: Create a policy-based follow-up and prepare a cautious customer response after checking the receipt.

nodeGroups.name: Respond and reread
nodeGroups.description: Send the authorized response and retrieve resulting state for verification.

nodeGroups.name: Completion contract
nodeGroups.description: Audit completed and skipped actions, identify remaining work, and emit one AutoWFBench submission.
